sonnet.problem: Card 1 already says Jesus is 'full of the Holy Spirit' just before the question asks who led Him into the wilderness, so the answer 'Spirit' is given away by the earlier card.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card re-tells the verse 12 answer the baker just picked on card 16, then adds a wrap-up of all three rounds (4:4, 8, 12). It moves nothing forward and works as a recap.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.
